# Fullsend

> Autonomous SDLC agents for your codebase

Fullsend is a platform for fully autonomous agentic development for
GitHub-hosted organizations. It provides triage, code generation, review, fix,
retro, and prioritization agents that operate on GitHub issues and pull
requests.

## Docs

The stable version is served at both `/docs/` and `/docs/v/stable/`. `/docs/v/`
has an HTML list of versions to explore. The stable version at `/docs/` is
usually enough. Source Markdown files ship alongside the HTML; add a `.md`
suffix (and `index.md` for directory URLs) to fetch them:
`/docs/agents/triage` → `/docs/agents/triage.md`, `/docs/agents/` →
`/docs/agents/index.md`. A hit returns `Content-Type: text/markdown`; a missing
Markdown page returns HTTP 404 with `Content-Type: text/html`. Old versions may
not have Markdown files.

- [Agents Overview](https://fullsend.sh/docs/agents/)
- [Triage Agent](https://fullsend.sh/docs/agents/triage)
